question: What is the full form of UNEP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations Environment Programme**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of **UNEP** is **United Nations Environment Programme**.
 
• UNEP is responsible for coordinating the United Nations' environmental activities and assisting developing countries in implementing environmentally sound policies and practices.
 
• It was established as a result of the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in June 1972 and is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya.
 
• UNEP's mission is to provide leadership and encourage partnership in caring for the environment by inspiring, informing, and enabling nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• UNEP's work encompasses a wide range of activities, including climate change, disaster and conflict, ecosystem management, environmental governance, chemicals and waste, resource efficiency, and environment under review.
 
• It collaborates with various stakeholders, including governments, private sector, civil society, and international organizations, to promote sustainable development worldwide.
 
• UNEP plays a crucial role in the implementation of the environmental dimension of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
 
• It also produces key reports such as the Global Environment Outlook (GEO) to provide comprehensive assessments of the state of the global environment.
